{"id":2020088465,"question_id":3965,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780397540,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2020088465/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Earliest Finish Time for Land and Water Rides I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int earliestFinishTime(vector<int>& landStartTime, vector<int>& landDuration, vector<int>& waterStartTime, vector<int>& waterDuration) {\n        int n = landStartTime.size();\n        int m = waterStartTime.size();\n\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                int op1 = max(landStartTime[j] + landDuration[j] , waterStartTime[j]) + waterDuration[j];\n\n                int op2 = max(waterStartTime[j] + waterDuration[j] , landStartTime[j]) + landDuration[j];\n\n                ans = min(op1 , op2);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"earliest-finish-time-for-land-and-water-rides-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2052}
